name: The Italian Campaign
notes: Includes Operation Compass. 60.23 in the scan points to Case 60.72 for victory conditions; they are printed at 60.82.

A place scores for the side holding it with a combat unit (non-parenthesised Close Assault rating) that can trace supply of at most one Game-Turn to a dump or city whose line leads back to Cairo (CW) or Tripoli (Italian).
If no Italian combat unit on the map can trace a supply line, the Commonwealth wins a Strategic Victory; otherwise the side with more points wins a plain Victory.
